Adverse Effects and Contraindications: Cyclizine may cause drowsiness, dry mouth, headache, dermatitis, nausea, urinary retention, double vision, excessive urination, and hypersensitivity reactions. It is contraindicated in patients with asthma, glaucoma, emphysema, chronic pulmonary disease, shortness of breath, or difficulty urinating due to prostate enlargement unless directed by a physician. Cyclizine should not be used concurrently with sedatives, tranquilizers, or other anticholinergic agents without medical supervision.
